name: recallai
description: DevBrain / RecallAI — local private RAG system over your dev tools.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @recallai/server" "npm run dev -w @recallai/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @recallai/server && npm run build -w @recallai/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @recallai/server && npm run typecheck -w @recallai/web && npm run typecheck -w @recallai/connectors && npm run typecheck -w @recallai/db && npm run typecheck -w @recallai/rag
